clips.title: The story
paras: Gatehouse Goods is a local Stormwind task involving the transport of a shipment up the stairs within Trias' Cheese. Because the cheese shop shares a floor with the adjacent gatehouse, goods can be quietly dropped outside the stockroom door for guards to collect. The arrangement highlights the tight, interconnected urban design of Stormwind's commercial and defensive quarters.

Gatehouse Goods entails a straightforward delivery task nestled within the bustling streets of Stormwind. The job requires carrying a gatehouse shipment up the interior stairs of Trias' Cheese. While the famed cheese shop is an entirely distinct business with its own separate inventory, its physical structure shares a floor with the neighboring gatehouse facilities. This architectural quirk makes the shop's upper landing a practical passage for moving supplies between neighboring quarters without disturbing the front avenues.

The delivery protocol is precise: couriers must leave the crate directly outside the stockroom door rather than carrying it inside. Regular gatehouse guards keep an eye on incoming traffic and assign personnel to retrieve packages as they return to their posts. Furthermore, the stockroom's door is deliberately built with inward-swinging hinges, ensuring that goods stacked outside will never block the entryway or hinder those inside from moving freely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself!
Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.
Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.
We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
